Test move declaration refactoring with dialogue support, focusing on cases where
there is no code action provided or the move is rejected due to import cycles,
illegal internal imports, or symbol or import conflicts.

-- capabilities.json --
{
	"experimental":{"interactiveResolve":{"inputTypes":["string"]}}
}

-- settings.json --
{
	"analyses": {"unusedfunc": false}
}

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/movedecl

go 1.20

-- availability/move.go --
package move //@codeaction(re"m()ove", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", err=re"found 0 CodeActions")

import "strings" //@codeaction(re"import()", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", err=re"found 0 CodeActions")

func Foo(a, b int) int { //@codeaction(re"fu()nc", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", title="Move declaration Foo")
    type Bar strings.Builder //@codeaction(re"B()ar", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", err=re"found 0 CodeActions")
    return 1 //@codeaction(re"return()", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", title="Move declaration Foo")
}

var a, b int //@codeaction(re"var ()a", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", err=re"found 0 CodeActions")

var c, d int //@codeaction(re"va()r", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", err=re"found 0 CodeActions")

type A struct {} //@codeaction(re"A", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", title="Move declaration A")

-- illegal/src/src.go --
package src

// Package-level name conflict: illegal/dest/dest.go already declares type ExistingConflict.
type ExistingConflict struct{} //@codeaction(re"ExistingConflict", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re"already declared in package dest")

// File-level import conflict: illegal/dest/dest.go imports "bytes", so bytes is in file scope.
func bytes() {} //@codeaction(re"bytes", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re"conflicts with symbol in the destination package")

// Import cycle: package "src" must import package "cycledest", but "cycledest" already imports "src".
func CycleTarget() {} //@codeaction(re"CycleTarget", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/cycledest/dest.go"}`, err=re"import cycle")
func useCycleTarget() {
	CycleTarget()
}

// Package "src" must import package "secret", but this is an illegal internal import.
func InternalTarget() {} //@codeaction(re"InternalTarget", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/sub/internal/secret/secret.go"}`, err=re"illegal import")
func useInternalTarget() {
	InternalTarget()
}

// Renamed-import conflict: illegal/dest/imports.go imports "bytes" renamed as conflict,
// so conflict is in that file's scope in package dest.
var conflict string //@codeaction(re"conflict", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re"conflicts with symbol in the destination package")

// Dot-import conflict: illegal/dest/other.go dot-imports "strings", which brings strings.Reader into file scope in package dest.
type Reader struct{} //@codeaction(re"Reader", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re"conflicts with symbol in the destination package")

func unexported() {}

func CallsUnexported1() { //@codeaction(re"CallsUnexported1", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(unexported\)`)
	unexported()
}

func CallsUnexported2() {
	unexported()
}

// Tests for when the move is not allowed because the dest file is in a different module,
// or in testdata, a vendor directory, or a directory beginning with "." or "_".

func Outside() {} //@codeaction(re"Outside", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/../x/x.go"}`, err=re"is not in module")

func Vendored() {} //@codeaction(re"Vendored", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/vendor/example.com/x/x.go"}`, err=re"ignored by the go command or vendored")

func NestedVendored() {} //@codeaction(re"NestedVendored", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/a/vendor/x/x.go"}`, err=re"ignored by the go command or vendored")

func InTestdata() {} //@codeaction(re"InTestdata", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testdata/x/x.go"}`, err=re"ignored by the go command or vendored")

func InUnderscoreDir() {} //@codeaction(re"InUnderscoreDir", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/_x/x.go"}`, err=re"ignored by the go command or vendored")

func InDotDir() {} //@codeaction(re"InDotDir", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/.x/x.go"}`, err=re"ignored by the go command or vendored")

// Unexported fields of a moving type are referenced by remaining code, through
// a selector, a keyed literal, or an unkeyed literal.
type HasField struct{ n int } //@codeaction(re"HasField", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(n\)`)

func ReadField(h HasField) int { return h.n }

type Keyed struct{ k int } //@codeaction(re"Keyed", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(k\)`)

var K = Keyed{k: 1}

type Unkeyed struct{ u int } //@codeaction(re"Unkeyed", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(u\)`)

var U = []*Unkeyed{{1}}

// Unexported fields of anonymous struct types are referenced by remaining code.
// Moving AnonMover also moves its dependencies, which declare anonymous struct
// fields in a nested type (x), a var (name), and a function result (px).
func AnonMover() { //@codeaction(re"AnonMover", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(name, px, x\)`)
	_, _, _ = Nested{}, AnonConfig, AnonPos
}

type Nested struct{ In struct{ x int } }

var AnonConfig = struct{ name string }{"x"}

func AnonPos() struct{ px, py int } { return struct{ px, py int }{1, 2} }

func useAnon(n Nested) int { return n.In.x + len(AnonConfig.name) + AnonPos().px }

// Moving only some of the names declared by a single spec is not supported.
// (No code action is offered on a name in a multi-name spec; see
// availability/move.go.) Here PairP is pulled in as a dependency.
func UsesPairP() int { return PairP } //@codeaction(re"UsesPairP", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`cannot move PairP: it is declared together with PairQ`)

func PairF() (int, int) { return 1, 2 }

var PairP, PairQ = PairF()

// Unexported fields of an anonymous struct are reached through a slice, map,
// channel, or pointer returned by a moving function.
func SliceZ() []struct{ sliceF string } { return nil } //@codeaction(re"SliceZ", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(sliceF\)`)

func MapZ() map[string]struct{ mapF string } { return nil } //@codeaction(re"MapZ", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(mapF\)`)

func ChanZ() chan struct{ chanF string } { return nil } //@codeaction(re"ChanZ", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(chanF\)`)

func PtrZ() *struct{ ptrF string } { return nil } //@codeaction(re"PtrZ", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(ptrF\)`)

func useContainers() string {
	return SliceZ()[0].sliceF + MapZ()["foo"].mapF + (<-ChanZ()).chanF + (*PtrZ()).ptrF
}

// An unexported method of a moving interface is called by remaining code.
type Hidden interface{ peek() } //@codeaction(re"Hidden", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/illegal/dest/dest.go"}`, err=re`illegal reference: symbols moving to the destination package \(peek\)`)

func usePeek(h Hidden) { h.peek() }

-- illegal/dest/imports.go --
package dest

import (
	conflict "bytes"
)

var buf conflict.Buffer

-- illegal/dest/dest.go --
package dest

import "bytes"

type ExistingConflict struct{}

func _() {
	_ = bytes.Buffer{}
}

-- illegal/dest/other.go --
package dest

import . "strings"

func _() {
	_ = Reader{}
}

-- illegal/cycledest/dest.go --
package cycledest

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedecl/illegal/src"

func _() {
	_ = src.ExistingConflict{}
}

-- sub/internal/secret/secret.go --
package secret

type Secret struct{}
